notes.title: Update v0.6.9! BIG TYPE REWORK!!!
notes.notes: [h1]v0.6.9![/h1][p][/p][p]Our biggest update ever!![/p][p]This update reworks the game to split up the Sculplings into [b]7 ADDITIONAL TYPES[/b]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131267/514435054ce5b218952ad59cc02d47e9f8266392.png"][/img][/p][p]In addition, the move set of [b]EACH AND EVERY SCULPLING[/b] has been completely rewokred and redesigned in a way that I believe adds a lot more depth and excitement to each monster. This meant adding [b]over 50 new moves[/b] to the game.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131267/4e19295f9a01042e0891dac35ecbe62d9af4cb11.png"][/img][/p][p]I have been SOOO excited for this update- I believe it adds A LOT more complexity to the game.[/p][p]I'm excited to hear what you guys think! Obviously a big change like this will require balancing in the next few weeks, there's a lot more combinations now so bear with me while we chip away at balance and small bug fixes in the following weeks![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks as always for the support guys- some more exciting updates in the works that I'm excited to share with you guys soon![/p][p][/p][p]-Conor[/p]

notes.title: V0.5.0 IS FINALLY HERE! 3rd Final Boss | Bug Fixes | QOL Improvements!
notes.notes: [h1]V0.5.0 Is finally here![/h1][p][/p][p][/p][p]This update adds a ton of new changes and improvements. The biggest is that the Rank #3 Final Boss: BEAST is now fightable! In addition some other things we've added:[/p][p][/p][p]- Selectable difficulty based on which of the game's final bosses you want to face off againt. You can choose which of the Big 5 to face off of by clicking the statue in the hub world.[/p][p]- A ton of bug fixes that were reported by you guys  [/p][p]- Some new abilities for existing Sculplings[/p][p]- New EGG event that adds an egg to your party (what will it hatch into??)[/p][p][/p][p]This update is pretty expansive and took way longer to do than I was anticipating, we changed a lot behind the scenes on how the game's data and progress is stored. Good news is that it makes future content of the game easier to scale. [/p][p]I'm happy to say that we're going back to more consistent updates for the forseeable future :) This update was kinda a bottle neck preventing us from fixing other things so now that it's out we'll continue to add and fix things at a more consistent rate. [/p][p]The next goal is to fix all the bugs that have been reported thus far and polish what's there already. In the next few weeks expect:[/p][p]- Bug Fixes[/p][p]- General UI polish across the game[/p][p]- More pins [/p][p]- Beating a boss again in a post-shogunaka difficulty will "upgrade" that boss' emblem to be more powerful [/p][p]- 'Hall of Fame' showing you what team you first beat one of the Big Five members with[/p][p]- New Sculplings in Grasslands and Restaurant[/p][p]- SFX polish[/p][p]- I'm thinking maybe "final boss" cutscenes throughout a run where the final boss introduces themselves in between zones[/p][p]- Monster moveset polish(I think some monsters have a pretty uninteresting move pool atm)[/p][p]- Fifth Sculpling type that is super effective against itself- I'm thinking a "Fantasy" type[/p][p]- Unlockable Spoody 3rd evolution at the Lab[/p][p]- Option to drop inventory items when its full instead of the very low quality inventory full screen currently there[/p][p]Overall, I want the game to be very close to the level of polish/content I want for the full release before I add in the last two final bosses. I feel like there's enough content there now with the 3rd final boss for me to focus on making the content that's already there better :) [/p][p]Still planning on adding in the last two bosses at some point of course, but prob won't be until September/October[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for your patience guys, I'm excited to get back to more regular updates :)[/p][p][/p][p]Also, thank you so much for all the positive reviews, it's honestly so motivating to see. I also have been loving reading your ideas posted through the feedback form in game or here on steam, I'd love to work with you guys to get some cool ideas in the game :)[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Conor[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: V0.3.5! Polish and Bug Fixes! Price Update Announcement!
notes.notes:

[/h2]
Thanks for all the new support and reviews guys! Really inspiring to see :)

[h2]Major changes:[/h2]

I know there's still bugs and content to be done, but I think we've done a lot to the game since we launched at $5 3 months ago and it's time to bump up the price a bit? I hope that seems fair. At the very least, this will give us a lot of room to do more frequent sales on the game cause right now it seems a little wild to put a discount on what's already a super low price for the amount of work we've put into it haha.

This will be the only price bump for awhile. Maybe after the summer may raise it to $9 and the full release I'm planning on selling it for $12 or so.

I'll of course always give a warning when a price increase is coming up. Honestly I'll give more of a warning in the future, this one has to happen soon so that we can be part of the summer sale :)

Anyway, just FYI! Thanks so much again for all the support and reviews. Couldn't do it without you guys, really.

notes.title: Update: v0.2.1: 2nd Final Boss | Difficulty Increases
notes.notes:
[h1]VERSION 0.2.1[/h1]

Major changes: 

- [b]2ND FINAL BOSS![/b] After defeating Rank #5, the next run will end with you facing off against rank #4

- Opponent scaling once you defeat the first final boss(opponents get harder and have slightly different teams)

- Unlockable active items in the Hub Item Shop once you defeat the first final boss

- UI polish

- Fix many reported bugs

- Additional outfits to unlock

- Several new moves across several different monsters

I've tested it as much as I could, but I'm not gonna lie: some of the post-first-final-boss content will be an ongoing process in terms of balancing. A lot of the opponents change slightly once you defeat Shogunaka and should only be *slightly* more difficult than before, but they have different teams and everything so if you run into an opponent that you think has become far too difficult please let me know. There's only so much time I can take to run through the game over and over to balance. 

[h3]Next Week:[/h3]

The next couple weeks we're gonna take a pause on adding a lot of new content and instead focus on polishing and balancing what's already there. I've been meaning to go back and do things like:

- Change some badges to be better/more interesting
- Have a more unique and varied pool of moves for starting Sculplings
- Do more visual and audio feedback for attacks to make fighting more satisfying 
- Add and tweak sound effects throughout the game, especially things like monster's moves
- Add more visual flair to UI throughout the game and redesign some UI that has pretty much just been placeholder since the start
- Show the TOTAL damage being done to the target in the move tooltip

In addition, we're always fixing bugs alongside the work we do, but there's been a few that have been around for awhile that I'd like to take a break and clean up.

That said, there will still be a few new things we're looking to add in the next couple weeks that you can look forward to:

- New Sculpling in CANYONLANDS
- New Pins

Be sure to lmk what you think of the new update! And thanks again for all the bug reports/feedback you guys have been providing, we really couldn't make the game great without you :)

- Conor

Thanks again :)

notes.title: Game Release/ Next Steps!
notes.notes:
Great news! Sculplings is now available for download!

Lee and I have been working on this project for over a year and, although there's still plenty to do, we're excited to finally take this major step and have it available to download!

We're super proud of the work we've done on this game so far, but there's still a lot I want to add before my vision for this project is complete :)

You can look forward to new Sculplings added to the game every TWO weeks(the first new one is already coming next week!) as well as TONS of additional content Lee and I are working on!

The current short term plan for Sculplings is as follows:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131267/cac2dfa008fe3fae55076954ecda08fcbe9d2249.png[/img]

Of course, we're open to any/all changes to this plan based on YOUR feedback in the game's official Discord!

Thank you all so much for your support on the launch. I'm SO excited for the future of this project and your support now means the world to me. I'm dedicated to making this the best game it can be.

- Conor
